title: nan
authors: Trujillo J.-C.; Munguia R.; Urzua S.; Grau A.
key_contribution: Presents a target-centric cooperative visual SLAM system and Lyapunov control law allowing aerial robot swarms to track non-cooperative dynamic targets in GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
